I can’t help you fake a mental illness or coach you on getting government disability pay fraudulently.
If you’re struggling and need support, I can help in ways that won’t put you at legal risk:
figure out whether your real symptoms might qualify for help
explain how disability claims are usually documented legitimately
help you organize medical records, work limitations, and treatment history
help you write a truthful personal-impact statement
